$comment: Structured-output schema for `claude -p --json-schema`. The CLI requires a top-level type of 'object' (it wraps the schema as a tool's input_schema), so the array of papercut records is nested under 'records' rather than being the top-level type itself. The extractor script reads back .structured_output.records. Each item carries exactly the 5 descriptive fields papercut_append.py accepts on stdin; every other field (id, v, producer, ts, machine, source, session_id, repo) is populated downstream by the gate, never by the model.
